				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span>AgState Grain Marketing</span></h2>
<h3><em>Your Partner in Risk Management Success</em><em></em></h3>
<p><span></span></p>
<p><span>Take the guesswork out of grain marketing. Our expert team delivers customized strategies, real-time insights, and tools to help you maximize profitability while minimizing risk. Let our trusted AgState team help to protect your operation through every market shift.</span></p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_2_3 et_pb_column_10  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Cash</strong></span> — Futures + Basis</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Basis</strong></span> — Establish basis for delivery month, set futures at a later date.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>NBE (No Basis Established)</strong></span> — Establish futures price and set basis at a later date or upon delivery.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>FOFR (Futures Offer)</strong></span> — Futures only offer that automatically sells if futures trade through established target price.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>COFR (Cash Offer)</strong></span> — Cash only offer that automatically sells if cash price trades through established target price.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Seasonal Averaging Contract </strong></span>— Sells equal amount of bushels every day at the close during a specific time frame of your choosing.</p>
<ul>
<li>Accumulate prices during historical highs throughout the year</li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Extend Price</strong></span> — Receive a cash advance on bushels delivered and establish a long futures position on a deferred futures month of your choosing.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>EMM (Equal Min. – Max.)</strong></span> — Sets a floor and a ceiling while selling an equal amount of bushels each trading day.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Minimum Price</strong></span> — Provides flexibility to establish a floor price.</p>
<p><span style="color: #00945e;"><strong>Options</strong></span> — Establish a floor with upside potential or maintain upside on a current cash position.</p>
<p><strong>Premium Offer</strong> — Premium is paid in exchange for a firm offer to sell additional grain for deferred delivery at an established price.</p>
<p><strong>Accumulator</strong> — Sell at a premium to the market with the options of:</p>
<ul>
<li>No knockout accumulator</li>
<li>Knockout accumulator</li>
<li>No double up knockout accumulator</li>
</ul>
<p><em></em></p>
<p><em>* Contracts denoted in black have potential contingent obligations if price closes AT or ABOVE agreed upon offer </em><em>price on expiration. All contract details are governed by AgState and RJO/StoneX contracts and addendums. </em></p></div>
